<!-- pr-reviewer: f6b7ad0e5e27a851ece0c3b21bd4930d0ad1a222 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The machine file uses the repository's program-coordinate travel convention. The axis speeds match the published configuration. The tests pin the 3,000 rpm limit, manual tool change, and flood coolant. The posting test confirms that the post reports a mist coolant request by name.

### Results on the local trial merge

The first parent is the PR head above. The second parent is upstream main at `10ea81a2a1da2f883d43385757db802e83c99fd1`.

- Quick gate passed all 294 steps. The two builds passed. The 292 test steps reported 2,258 passes, eight ignored tests, and zero failures.
- Main suites passed. App library 310, machine 33, machine library 18, LinuxCNC post 10, posting 17, rigid tapping 5, and shipped from disk 3.
- Clippy passed for all targets in camcraft-app and camcraft-post, with warnings treated as errors.
- Light gate passed all six steps, including the release build and 11 light tests.

### Extra suites run

- Example catalog 43 passed and four ignored. Example catalog adaptive and example catalog edge work each passed one test.
- Solid-law goldens passed seven tests. The CL golden suite passed 34. The LinuxCNC script golden suite passed 11.
- The diff changes no recorded NC or CL programs and no files in the example catalog.

### Safety checks

- Set `rigid_tapping` to `false` in a temporary copy. The LinuxCNC posting test failed at the spindle encoder diagnostic. Restored the original input and the test passed.
- Changed `max_speed` from 3,000 to 3,500 rpm in a temporary copy. The machine library test failed at the spindle limit assertion. Restored the original input and the test passed.
- The tests exercise CamCraft. The review did not run a program on the mill. This P6 change does not require a heavy lane at review under upstream #3556.

### Requested before merge

1. `assets/machines/mikron-wf3-dcm-linuxcnc.mch:19` enables `G33.1` on the published retrofit. Its HAL connects spindle position feedback, but the spindle index signal connects only to motion and the spindle PID. LinuxCNC waits for the encoder to clear the index request before it starts the synchronized move. Supply evidence that the controller configuration supports rigid tapping, or remove the capability and update the posting test to check the refusal. The current test only reads the generated NC text. [Mikron spindle HAL](https://github.com/paulsvc/linuxcnc-mill2-config/blob/ea22af1a7d668c7ff030ca367a1e48485f195d70/mill2.hal#L255-L281) · [Encoder feedback HAL](https://github.com/paulsvc/linuxcnc-mill2-config/blob/ea22af1a7d668c7ff030ca367a1e48485f195d70/custom.hal#L61-L64) · [LinuxCNC synchronized motion requirements](https://www.linuxcnc.org/docs/2.9/html/gcode/g-code.html#gcode:g33)
2. `AGENTS.md:313` and `:319` require the fixing commit and the PR body to end with `Fixes #3244`. The commit has no body, and the PR body has three lines after the issue reference. Put the reference on the last line of both. In the PR body, also state that the verification did not run on the mill.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Hi @paulsvc. Two items are still open on the Mikron WF3 machine file from the last review:
1. `G33.1` is enabled, but the published retrofit's spindle index signal isn't wired to the spindle PID, so rigid tapping can't be trusted on that HAL. Either leave `G33.1` off for this machine, or point to the HAL lines that make it safe.
2. The commit and the PR body need `Fixes #3244` as their last line.

Both are small. Push when you can and we'll re-review. If you're busy, say so and we can make the change (maintainer edits are allowed).

@paulsvc the Mikron WF3 DCM machine file waits on two review items of head `f6b7ad0e5`:
1. `G33.1` (rigid tapping) is enabled in `assets/machines/mikron-wf3-dcm-linuxcnc.mch:19`, but the published HAL does not connect the spindle index to `spindle.N.index-enable`. Please disable `G33.1`, or show the HAL connection.
2. Put `Fixes #3244` on the last line of the PR body and of the fixing commit body.

Do you want to finish it yourself? If you prefer, our pool can make these two changes on your branch (this PR allows maintainer edits). Under the takeover rules we need your explicit approval. If you agree, please reply "go ahead" and release your writer turn on #3244.
